correctness.rationale: Campbell–Cloitre Corollaries 16,23 and Theorem 26 provide the morphisms and digit characterization. The pair language S4=S5 of M1 is stabilized and complete, making ten level-three two-block words an exact cover for all factors up to length 18. Enumerated palindrome complexities in these exact blocks are (2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,3,0,3,0,2,0,2,0,0); centered length-11/18 obstructions prove no longer palindrome. The supplied standalone checker replayed successfully, including independent nested-recurrence comparisons. For M2, the digit formula implies an eight-uniform binary morphism with two palindromic images, proving palindrome prefixes of length 8^r by induction.

value.rationale: For the newly defined natural pair of meta-automatic sequences, the exact 28-element palindromic language and length-16 boundary distinguish M1 structurally from M2, which has palindromic prefixes at every power of 8. This finite-versus-unbounded dichotomy is absent from the ordinary factor-complexity treatment. The nontrivial exact-cover argument makes the finite result reproducible and explains why it is complete. This is a precise natural invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a routine restatement.
